profile.reading: This facility in New York is attributed to Clarkson University, a private research university. A Wikipedia fetch for Clarkson University described several student facing computing spaces, including the largely student run Applied CS Labs (Clarkson Open Source Institute, Internet Teaching Lab, and Virtual Reality Lab), which also hosts an open source software mirror serving downloads for projects like Blender and Ubuntu, plus Clarkson Ignite makerspaces, but none of these describe enterprise level data center or IT infrastructure. This is very likely a university owned enterprise data center for administrative and research computing rather than a commercial facility, though its specific building identity was not confirmed.
profile.research_note: Institution confirmed; no specific data center facility detail found. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.
